name: Neon MCP Server
what: Neon's official MCP server for managing Neon Postgres in plain language: create projects and branches, run queries, inspect schemas and run migrations on a branch. It is offered as a hosted remote server with OAuth or API-key auth. MIT licensed.
who: Developers using Neon Postgres for local development. Neon says it is meant for development and IDE use, not production, so review every action before approving it.

setup.text: Quick setup for Cursor, VS Code and Claude Code (signs you in and configures the editor):
Or add the hosted server to all detected agents with OAuth:
Or add it to your MCP config by hand; an OAuth window opens on first use:
To limit what the agent can do, uncheck Allow writes on the OAuth page, or use https://mcp.neon.tech/mcp?readonly=true.

prompts: Create a new Neon project called my-app with a users table (id, name, email).
Add a created_at column to the users table on a new branch first, then show me the diff.
Summarize all of my Neon projects and what tables each one has.
